messages:
Mira: FYI — after rolling base-image rbi-2026-03-15-nvtoolkit to us-west1, ~5% of GPU pods fail to start. Runtime errors about missing libcuda/libnvidia-ml. Full error snippet below.

ops-bot: [k8s-event] Pod gpu-infer-42 CrashLoopBackOff: container runtime error: failed to attach device: could not find 'libnvidia-ml'

Tony: Reproduced on staging. Reverting nvidia-container-toolkit to 1.10.0 in our base-image fixes the start. Suspect 1.12 changed mount behavior.

Lee: Can someone paste the failing containerd logs? I wonder if it's a kernel/driver mismatch or nctk mount path change.

Mira: ```
2026-03-12T14:02:03Z containerd: time=\"2026-03-12T14:02:03Z\" level=error msg=\"failed to start container: error creating device for GPU: open /usr/lib/libnvidia-ml.so.1: no such file or directory\"
2026-03-12T14:02:03Z dockerd: nvidia-container-cli: initialization error: driver not loaded or incompatible with user-space
```

Anika: Quick workarounds we've tried in staging: 1) pin nvidia-container-toolkit to 1.10.0 in the base image build; 2) add node-level bind mount of /run/nvidia:/usr/local/nvidia:ro in the GPU daemonset; 3) explicitly pass --gpus=all to docker runtime. Pinning nctk was the only consistently reliable fix.

Drew: INF-1223 created to block bakery promotion and trigger rollback. Rolling cordon/drain -> reimage for affected nodes. Tracking in the infra runbook.

Tony: Action items: @eng-oncall rollback base image for us-west1, add image pin in bakery templates, and run cluster-wide healthcheck for libcuda symlinks and driver versions. I'll own the postmortem.

Mira: Adding a short checklist to the runbook: if you see "libnvidia" mount errors, check nctk package version in the image, verify kernel driver (nvidia-smi) matches driver ABI, and confirm /run/nvidia is present on the host.

eng-oncall: On it — cordoning 3 nodes in us-west1 and reimaging with rbi-2026-03-10-nctk1.10. Patching bakery to pin nctk until we finish compatibility testing. Logs will be posted here. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: [deploybot] Rollback started: bakery-image rbi-2026-03-10-nctk1.10 -> us-west1 (3 nodes)

Drew: Observed success on 2/3 nodes after reimage; last node still reimaging. No new CrashLoopBackOffs on reimaged nodes.

Mira: After stabilization let's add a preflight in bakery that validates presence of /usr/lib/libnvidia-ml.so (or equivalent) and runs a quick container start test with --gpus to catch this early.

Tony: Also suggest an automated metric: alert on container start failures containing 'libnvidia' or 'nvidia-container-cli' to catch regressions faster.

Mira: Agree. Once the rollback is complete I'll move this to postmortems/ and draft the RCA. Thanks everyone for the fast response.
